title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP11c — profile authority registry prep
goal: Let the current trusted base recognize the exact destination directories and validate an explicit head layout before the authorized physical profile split.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry recognizes only direct JSON children in the three frozen destination directories and creates no authority file.
The candidate verifier selects explicit layout only when the head manifest exists, otherwise legacy directory mode, with no fallback after selection.
Production callers, active authority paths, generated views, CI and required checks remain unchanged.
The subsequent physical migration removes the temporary migration entries.
